stats.stock_value_definition: Maximum actually displayed confirmed stock estimate per shop and episode, summed across shops and episodes; self-reported.
stats.vehicle_definition: One self-reported vehicle completion per shop and episode.
stats.alert_definition: Telegram API acceptance; does not establish delivery or reading. Latency is measured from event receipt to API acceptance.
stats.virtual_alert_definition: Local virtual delivery simulation; no Telegram API call, delivery/read receipt or real self-report.
